record.paper_title: Some Open Questions in Quiver Gauge Theory
record.original_question: Can one define a notion of symplectic duality for affine Grassmannians, analogous to symplectic duality between Higgs and Coulomb branches?

evidence.quote: Question 10. Can we have some notion of symplectic duals for the affine Grassmannians?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
In the framework of three-dimensional N=4 supersymmetric gauge theories, symplectic duality is a conjectural correspondence pairing certain conical symplectic resolutions (X, X^!) with matching algebraic and representation-theoretic structures; canonical examples arise as Higgs and Coulomb branches of a gauge theory and its mirror. Affine Grassmannian slices (closures of intersections of opposite semi-infinite orbits in the affine Grassmannian Gr_G of a complex reductive group G), and more generally generalized affine Grassmannian slices, are known to carry Poisson structures and to admit symplectic resolutions, and in many cases arise as Coulomb branches of quiver gauge theories whose Higgs branches are Nakajima quiver varieties.

Problem: Formulate an intrinsic notion of "symplectic dual" for the affine Grassmannian Gr_G itself (or for its slices and their generalizations), analogous to the symplectic duality relating Higgs and Coulomb branches. Specifically:

(a) Define, in a coordinate-free way, what it should mean for two (ind-)Poisson varieties associated to G and to a possibly different group G^! to be symplectic duals at the level of affine Grassmannians.

(b) Verify that the proposed definition reproduces the known symplectic duality between affine Grassmannian slices for G (or its Langlands dual) and Nakajima quiver varieties in finite ADE type.

(c) Identify the symplectic dual partner of the full affine Grassmannian Gr_G, or prove that no such partner can exist within an appropriate category of (ind-)symplectic varieties.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g., Kamnitzer's 2022 survey on symplectic resolutions, symplectic duality, and Coulomb branches; Krylov–Perunov; Muthiah–Weekes and others) has established that generalized affine Grassmannian slices arise as Coulomb branches and are symplectic dual to Nakajima quiver varieties in finite ADE type. However, no general intrinsic notion of symplectic duality directly for the affine Grassmannian itself (rather than its slices) appears to have been formulated; the question of an overarching symplectic-dual framework for affine Grassmannians remains open.

status_evidence.title: Symplectic resolutions, symplectic duality, and Coulomb branches (Kamnitzer)
status_evidence.snippet: Symplectic duality is the observation that symplectic resolutions come in pairs with matching properties. The Coulomb branch construction allows us to produce and study many of these dual pairs.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys current state; symplectic duality understood between slices in affine Grassmannians and Nakajima quiver varieties, but a general notion for affine Grassmannians per se is not formulated.

status_evidence.title: Hamiltonian reduction for affine Grassmannian slices and truncated shifted Yangians
status_evidence.snippet: Generalized affine Grassmannian slices are Coulomb branches, symplectic dual to Nakajima quiver varieties.
status_evidence.claim: Symplectic duality is established for slices, supporting partial progress on the broader question.
